advances: An incidence statement for already realized positive winner cells. It imposes no cap volume bound and makes no depth assertion.
author: PK-research-agent
proof:
On $D_k$, $L_k-L_i$ is nonnegative and positive outside the tie set, which has measure zero. Integration on the positive-mass cell and affinity give the formula and strict positivity for $\Delta_{ki}$. Now
$$
\ell_i(y_k)=L_k(y_k)-L_i(y_i)-\Delta_{ki}.
$$
After weighting by $\alpha_{ik}$ the first two terms cancel by equality of row and column sums. A directed cycle would give a nonzero circulation supported on edges with nonnegative left summands, contradicting the strictly negative right side. Subtraction of $\ell_i(y_k)$ from $h_i(y_k)$ gives the two displayed corrections. If the continuous coefficients agree and every used edge has nonnegative margin, rearranging gives the positive base-correction bound. For each balanced family the continuous term cancels pointwise in the average $\sum_r\rho_{ir}h_{ir}(z,x)$, leaving $(\sum_r\rho_{ir}a_{ir})\cdot(z-j_i)$. Evaluation at $y_k$ and summation against $\alpha_{ik}$ gives precisely the stated averaged identity.
statement:
Let $C$ be a compact mixed-integer convex body with intrinsic mixed measure $\mu$. Let $L_i(z,x)=\beta_i+b_i\cdot z+u_i\cdot x$ be finitely many affine scores, with $\mu$-null pairwise ties and positive-mass winner cells $D_i=C\cap\bigcap_{k\ne i}\{L_i\ge L_k\}$. In particular, null ties hold when the score differences are nonconstant on each positive intrinsic fiber. Write $t_i=\mu(D_i)$, $y_i=(j_i,c_i)$ for its mixed centroid and $\ell_i=L_i-L_i(y_i)$. Then
$$
\Delta_{ki}=L_k(y_k)-L_i(y_k)=t_k^{-1}\int_{D_k}(L_k-L_i)\,d\mu>0\quad(k\ne i).
$$
For every nonnegative off-diagonal circulation $\alpha$ (its row and column sums agree label by label),
$$
\sum_{i,k}\alpha_{ik}\ell_i(y_k)=-\sum_{i,k}\alpha_{ik}\Delta_{ki}.
$$
Consequently the relation $i\to k$ for $i\ne k$ and $\ell_i(y_k)\ge0$ is acyclic. For arbitrary centered margins $h_i(z,x)=a_i\cdot(z-j_i)+v_i\cdot(x-c_i)$ the corresponding identity is
$$
\sum_{i,k}\alpha_{ik}h_i(y_k)=
-\sum_{i,k}\alpha_{ik}\Delta_{ki}
+\sum_{i,k}\alpha_{ik}\big[(a_i-b_i)\cdot(j_k-j_i)+(v_i-u_i)\cdot(c_k-c_i)\big].
$$
In particular, if $v_i=u_i$, $\alpha\ne0$ and every positive-weight edge captures its destination, the base correction is at least $\sum_{i,k}\alpha_{ik}\Delta_{ki}>0$. For finite families $h_{ir}$ of such margins with weights $\rho_{ir}\ge0$, $\sum_r\rho_{ir}=1$ and $\sum_r\rho_{ir}v_{ir}=0$, the averaged circulation is exactly $\sum_{i,k}\alpha_{ik}(\sum_r\rho_{ir}a_{ir})\cdot(j_k-j_i)$.
title: Strict incidence circulation for affine winner cells
